About Sita

Sita is a journey into the oldest crafts known to humanity. From brain-tanning hides to working with bone and wood, every piece tells a story of patience, respect for nature, and a deep connection to ancestral knowledge. Here you will find handcrafted leather goods, stories from the workshop, and resources to learn these timeless skills yourself.
